understanding.goal_understanding: The goal was to complete the level by activating all goal cells on the grid. A goal cell is completed by stepping onto it only when the carried piece exactly matches that goal’s required shape, color, and rotation. Completing all goals advances to the next level, and winning all levels completes the game.
understanding.mechanics_understanding: Each turn I choose a movement action (north/south/east/west). Movement can be blocked by walls, in which case my position doesn’t change but stamina is still spent. As I move, stepping on modifier tiles changes the attributes of my carried piece: shape modifiers cycle the piece’s shape, color modifiers cycle the piece’s color, and rotation modifiers rotate the piece 90° clockwise. I must route through these modifiers to transform my piece to match a goal’s requirements, then step onto the goal tile to activate it. Every action consumes stamina; when stamina reaches 0, the next action depletes it and costs a life, then stamina resets. Losing all lives ends the game.
